name: easi.run
shortDescription: Self-hosted Chrome for external AI agents via MCP/REST, with live viewing and human takeover.
longDescription: Isolated real Chrome sessions for external AI agents via MCP and REST, with encrypted profiles, live viewing, human takeover for logins, 2FA and approvals, file transfers, downloads, recordings and audio. The connected agent/model supplies reasoning. Free AGPL-3.0-only software; bring your own Linux x86-64 server with systemd and rootful Docker Engine 28+, plus your agent/model, with hosting and model costs separate. This stdio configuration connects to an already installed, running easi.run stack; it is not an installer. Remote Streamable HTTP uses your own authenticated /mcp endpoint. No shared public endpoint or npm package. Docs: https://docs.easi.run Demo: https://easi.run/demo . Submitted by creator Juliano Gouveia; listing prepared with AI assistance.
author: julianosig

prerequisites: Your own Linux x86-64 server with systemd and rootful Docker Engine 28+
Install the official easi.run stack first: https://docs.easi.run
Your own compatible MCP agent/model; hosting and model costs are separate

installSteps.title: Deploy easi.run on your server
installSteps.description: Follow https://docs.easi.run to deploy the official stack; do not run the MCP command before the admin container is available.

installSteps.title: Configure your MCP client
installSteps.description: Use the Docker stdio configuration on the machine running the easi.run stack. Replace container name only if your deployment uses a different admin container.
